My Chief of Staff has a very particular set of skills. She is also a mushroom.

Celia runs the week. Meeting notes, task capture, team broadcasts, planning. You said yes to eleven things and her whole job is making sure all eleven actually happen.

You wake up and your inbox is already read. She tells you which three actually need you, why, and hands you the drafts. You say send. Clean inbox in seconds.

She works 24/7. You do not.

One brain underneath. A whole crew growing out of it. Celia is one of them.

What would you "hire" Celia for? 🍄
